about: Looks inspired by the character of film stocks. Each is EFAS's own approximation, made by converting the tone, saturation and colour-balance settings of the matching film-look preset from another program's published list into EFAS's sliders (see docs/presets.md); they are not a measurement of the film and not a copy of anyone's profile. They are starting points: adjust by eye.

presets.name: Film Stocks/Cinestill/Cinestill
presets.description: A CineStill-style look: a little more saturation and punch, slightly deeper shadows and brighter highlights.

presets.name: Film Stocks/Fuji/Superia
presets.description: A Fuji Superia-style look: deeper shadows, a little extra saturation and a faint green-yellow balance.

presets.name: Film Stocks/Kodak/Gold
presets.description: A Kodak Gold-style look: warm, yellow shadows and midtones with clean highlights, deeper shadows and a little extra saturation. Uses the Lab Look module for the warmth by tone.

presets.name: Film Stocks/Kodak/Portra
presets.description: A Kodak Portra-style look: soft, protected highlights, deeper shadows and a hint of warmth.

presets.name: Film Stocks/Kodak/Portra Airy
presets.description: A lighter, airier Portra: lifted shadows and highlights with a warm balance and firmer blacks.
